resources.string: No documents yet.\n\nOpen a PDF and it will show up here, so you can pick up where you left off.
This document is no longer accessible. It may have been moved or deleted, or the permission was revoked.
This PDF is password protected. SlimPDF cannot open encrypted documents.
No app on this device can pick files.

Why: when another app opens a PDF in SlimPDF, it only lends the file while it is open. With this access, SlimPDF can reopen it from recents later, straight from where it is saved on your phone.\n\nWithout it, SlimPDF keeps its own copy of each such PDF, which takes space and does not show later changes to the original. SlimPDF only reads PDFs; it never changes or deletes files.
SlimPDF needs access to all files

Why: this PDF is in recents by where it is saved on your phone, and reading it from there needs access to all files, which is now off.\n\nAllow it again, or pick the file once and SlimPDF will keep access to that file only. You stay on the same page either way.
SlimPDF cannot read this PDF where it is saved without access to all files.
